lines.zh: 我四条腿慢慢挪，地面在响。
lines.en: Four legs shift and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 前腿比后腿长，走路像在上坡。
lines.en: My forelegs are longer, so I walk as if uphill.
My neck reaches out to the treetops.
One stride clears the whole stream.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，尾巴扫过灌木。
lines.en: Each step, my tail sweeps the shrubs.
The canopy sways as I push through.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为太重了。
lines.en: I move slowly. I'm heavy.
Grass flattens in patches under me.

lines.zh: 林缘的草高，正好遮住蹄印。
lines.en: The tall edge grass hides my prints.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，穿过枝条。
lines.en: I lower my head to pass the branches.
I lift a foreleg over a fallen tree.

lines.zh: 脖子上的皮肤在阳光下起伏。
lines.en: The skin of my neck shifts in the sun.

lines.zh: 我停下，把重心换到另一边。
lines.en: I stop and shift my weight.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看，脖子绕了个弯。
lines.en: I look back, my neck curving round.

lines.zh: 我循着湿土的气味去喝水。
lines.en: I follow the smell of wet earth to water.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下深深的坑。
lines.en: Deep prints follow me.

lines.zh: 脖子伸到树冠，我立着不动。
lines.en: Neck up in the canopy, I stand still.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着高处的叶子。
lines.en: I chew leaves from high up.
Wind passes my ears.

lines.zh: 我换了条腿支着，歇一歇。
lines.en: I shift my weight to another leg and rest.
The canopy is right at my mouth.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂着，几乎不动。
lines.en: My tail hangs almost still.
From up here I can see far.
My breathing is deep.
My back warms and I half-close my eyes.
I lower my head and look at the ground.
I don't intend to move.
I curve my neck.

lines.zh: 叶子在我嘴里发出声音。
lines.en: Leaves rustle in my mouth.
I lower my head, neck bending.
You look very small.
Across several trees, I size you up.
I bring my head a little closer.

lines.zh: 你往后挪，我跟着低了低头。
lines.en: You step back; I dip my head after you.
My feet stop; my head stays turned to you.

lines.zh: 你衣上有青草，也有铁锈味。
lines.en: Your clothes smell of grass and rust.
Neck lowered, I look down on you.

lines.zh: 我看了你一阵，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I watch you a while and blink slowly.
I blink once.

lines.zh: 痛从背上沉下去，我闷哼一声。
lines.en: The pain sinks through my back and I grunt low.

lines.zh: 前腿上这一下，震到骨头。
lines.en: That blow on my foreleg reaches the bone.
My body lists, then rights itself.
Blood seeps through my thick hide.

lines.zh: 我偏过身，脖子弯下来看你。
lines.en: I turn my flank and bend my neck to see you.
Each breath comes longer and heavier.
I can't retreat, only shield.
The wound is hot.
Four legs still hold me up.
I look at you without anger.
These leaves are good.
I can see what you're holding up.
I lower my head to your hand.

lines.zh: 这点叶子，填不满我的嘴。
lines.en: These leaves won't fill my mouth.

lines.zh: 高处的叶子，我嚼得从容。
lines.en: Leaves from on high, chewed at leisure.
Bring more.
My neck reaches a long way.
You needn't hold it high.

lines.zh: 嫩叶的甜味飘到我的鼻尖。
lines.en: The sweetness of young leaves reaches my snout.
After this, I'd still eat.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，弹了回去。
lines.en: You hit my leg and bounce back.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我只晃了晃皮。
lines.en: You hit me; only my hide sways.

lines.zh: 我低下脖子，看你有没有事。
lines.en: I lower my neck to check on you.
You end up sitting on the ground.
I shift a step.

lines.zh: 我落脚没收住，震得你踉跄。
lines.en: I can't check my step; you stumble.
I hope that didn't hurt you.
I stand and wait for you to rise.
Try again and I'll step aside.
I ease over to the side.
There is kin in the wood.
We regard each other across several trees.
Its neck is straighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并肩站着，树冠被挤开。
lines.en: We stand together and the canopy parts.
Neither moves first.

lines.zh: 我们一起吃同一片树冠。
lines.en: We feed from the same canopy.
My kin left first; the prints are fresh.
Two lines of deep prints remain.
This place can feed us both.

lines.zh: 同伴走了，我低头接着吃。
lines.en: My kin leaves; I lower my head and eat on.
I lower my head and take a branch.
It won't even fill the gaps in my teeth.
I curl it in with my tongue.
There are leaves still on it.
I grind it down little by little.
Dropped it. I can't be bothered.
Too high to reach.
I stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 伸长脖子，最嫩的枝到手。
lines.en: Neck stretched, the tenderest branch is mine.

lines.zh: 枝条嚼碎了，我才往下咽。
lines.en: I grind the branch before swallowing.
Something's moving.

lines.zh: 长颈一弯，我的头转了向。
lines.en: My long neck curves; my head turns.
I look down.

lines.zh: 它只有我一条腿那么高。
lines.en: It stands no taller than my leg.

lines.zh: 我垂着脖子，慢慢嚼叶子。
lines.en: Neck low, I chew leaves slowly.
But I'll keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 我把脖子抬起来，挡住幼崽。
lines.en: I raise my neck to block the young.

lines.zh: 那影子定住，我也停了脚。
lines.en: The shape freezes; my feet stop too.

lines.zh: 我和那影子对着望，不动。
lines.en: The shape and I hold each other's gaze.

lines.zh: 它抢在前面动了，我稳住脚。
lines.en: It moves first; I plant my feet.

lines.zh: 那影子走了，我才低下头。
lines.en: The shape leaves; only then do I lower my head.
I lower my head.
Its stirring still comes from the shadows.
I level my weight and stand waiting.
My legs are too heavy to run.
All I can do is stand.

lines.zh: 我在树后看见它绕向我背后。
lines.en: I see it slip behind me past the trees.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过，草叶贴在地上。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 它往后缩，我不追只看着。
lines.en: It shrinks back; I only watch, not chase.
Only when it's gone do I ease my feet.

lines.zh: 脚步声远了，林子里只剩风。
lines.en: The steps fade; only wind is left.
I lower my head and eat.

lines.zh: 没什么事了，我继续嚼叶。
lines.en: Nothing more; I go back to chewing.
The young are still at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把脖子抬得更高，好看清它。
lines.en: I raise my neck higher to see it.
I raise a foreleg and stomp.

lines.zh: 前蹄落下，地上多了个坑。
lines.en: My forehoof falls and leaves a crater.
I sweep it away with my tail.
I lower my long neck and butt with my brow.
That was slow.
It dodged.
I can't turn fast enough.
I put a leg in the way.
It has retreated far.
I don't follow.
I lower my leg slowly.
Standing is enough.
I rise up in the wood.
My neck breaks the canopy first.
Light lands on my back.

lines.zh: 蹄子试了两下，土是实的。
lines.en: Two test stamps; the ground holds.
Solid enough.
I lower my head and look around.
The trees are tall.
Not as tall as me.
I stretch my neck to the leaves.
The first bite is sweet.
Kin call in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬腿，朝那声音挪过去。
lines.en: I lift a leg and move toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我的脚一落，土就跳了一下。
lines.en: My foot lands and the soil leaps.

lines.zh: 树冠一晃，露出来的是我。
lines.en: The canopy parts and there I am.

lines.zh: 火爬上我的腿，我慢慢挪开。
lines.en: Fire climbs my leg; I shift away.

lines.zh: 我这么大的身子砸下来，地面塌了。
lines.en: A body this size caves the ground in.

lines.zh: 水只到我的胸口，我却站不起来。
lines.en: The water only reaches my chest, yet I can't right myself.
The blast blooms at my feet.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在厚皮上，只入了一点。
lines.en: An arrow bites the thick hide, barely deep.

lines.zh: 光缠住我的脖子，我甩不开。
lines.en: Light wraps my neck and I can't shake it.
A body this big gets hungry fast.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 脚下的空没有尽头，我还在坠。
lines.en: The void has no end; I keep falling.
